installCommand: if [ -f frontendd/package-lock.json ]; then npm --prefix frontendd ci; else npm ci; fi
buildCommand: if [ -f frontendd/package.json ]; then npm --prefix frontendd run build; else npm run build; fi
devCommand: if [ -f frontendd/package.json ]; then npm --prefix frontendd run dev; else npm run dev; fi
